name: ad-delegation-win
description: Practice-box helper (Active Directory, DC-only): sets or clears Kerberos delegation on a domain account. Vars: ACCOUNT (required, account name without the trailing $ for computers); ACCOUNT_TYPE (optional, 'computer' default or 'user'); MODE (optional, 'unconstrained' default or 'none'). MODE=unconstrained sets TrustedForDelegation AND TrustedToAuthForDelegation (the unconstrained-delegation misconfiguration -- any service on that host caches credential delegations); MODE=none clears both (the hardened state / revert path). Computers are created if missing so a lab can fabricate an app server object without a real machine. Must run AFTER the domain exists. Pairs with powershell_json checks over Get-ADComputer -Properties TrustedForDelegation,TrustedToAuthForDelegation.
